conviction_note: The Q3 revenue and cash numbers are already public (pre-announced 13 Oct), so this print turns on the first post-settlement outlook: how much of YUTREPIA is PH-ILD (management said new scripts split roughly evenly) and what replaces the reaffirmed >$1B 2027 ambition. That leans slightly negative after a +74% 20-day run-up and +15.6 vol-point put skew, but 22% of float short and a stale aggregator consensus ($186.6m revenue, $0.77 EPS) that the headline will 'beat' pull p_up back toward 50. Hence p_up 46 on a 10% absolute move gives -0.8. The findings sum to -0.3; the two measurements agree in sign and roughly in size.
bar: Revenue: Q3 YUTREPIA net product sales of $222.7m were pre-announced by the company in the 8-K of 2026-10-13 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001819576/000110465926115672/tm2627557d1_ex99-1.htm), so the reported quarter lands on its own pre-release (print_vs_bar 0). Aggregator consensus is stale and has one source: Earnings Whispers on 2026-11-03 shows $0.77 EPS (whisper $0.81) on $186.6m revenue (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/LQDA/22795), below the pre-announced figure; Finviz shows a $0.96 'next Q' EPS (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=LQDA). The EPS bar is disputed and unsourced to two agreeing sources, so the findings that depend on it are capped small. No company guidance for Q4 2026 or 2027 exists beyond the pre-ruling '>$1B net revenue in 2027' ambition (reaffirmed on the Q2 call per the EW preview).
positioning_check: Short interest is 17.30M shares, 22.34% of float, short ratio 4.99 (Finviz, settlement 2026-10-15, read 2026-11-09: https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=LQDA). So shorts rose roughly 37% into the settlement rally. Baseline: skew_25d +15.57 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.56, event-implied move 6.77% (straddle 11.79%, ATM spread 78% of mid, indicative only), run_up_20d +73.9%, run_up_5d +15.0%, +8.4% on 2026-11-09 alone to $48.12, -47% from the 52-week high. This is a crowded short sitting on a sharp rally.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-13 the company pre-announced Q3 YUTREPIA net sales of $222.7m (+31% q/q from $170.4m) and cash of $396.1m. Aggregator consensus still reads $186.6m revenue and $0.77 EPS (Earnings Whispers 2026-11-03), so the headline will print as a roughly 19% revenue beat against a stale number, though the market already has the real figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-08-12 the stock fell 10.5% when revenue beat ($171.7m vs $171.0m) and EPS missed ($0.74 vs $0.76). On 2026-05-11 it rose 25.6% on a 44% q/q sales jump and an EPS beat ($0.52 vs $0.41).
findings.why_not_priced: The fundamental number is priced: it has been public for four weeks. What is not priced is the headline-parsing effect of an aggregator consensus that was never updated (EW shows $186.6m against the $222.7m already disclosed). If that consensus had been refreshed, EW would show about $222m, not $186.6m.
findings.independence: The stale consensus comes from https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/LQDA/22795 (2026-11-03). The pre-announced figure comes from a different document, the company 8-K.

findings.finding: The Delaware court found infringement on 2026-09-30, inside Q3, and the $380.7m settlement was signed 2026-10-13. So Q3 GAAP results will likely carry a settlement accrual or charge of several hundred million dollars, turning GAAP EPS deeply negative (roughly -$3/share on about 89.5m shares) against a $0.77 consensus. United Therapeutics did book its side of the related Sandoz settlement in Q3 (a $66.5m accrual reversal).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior settlement charge. On 2026-08-12 a 2-cent EPS miss coincided with a -10.5% day, so this name's headline EPS has mattered.
findings.why_not_priced: The dollars are fully known. Only the accounting timing (Q3 accrual vs Q4 expense) and the resulting headline GAAP 'miss' are not visible in any consensus. If it were priced, consensus GAAP EPS would be negative, not $0.77. This is an inference about accounting, so it is sized small, and it is a one-off with no path to the guide.
findings.independence: UTHR's Q3 release recognised the Sandoz piece of the same settlement in Q3: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001082554/000108255426000036/uthrq32026-ex991.htm (2026-11-04). That is a counterparty's accounting choice, not Liquidia's.

findings.finding: This is the first call since the settlement, and it must quantify the PH-ILD exit. Management said on the Q4-2025 and Q1-2026 calls that new YUTREPIA prescriptions split roughly evenly between PAH and PH-ILD, and on the Q2 call it reaffirmed '>$1B net revenue in 2027'. Liquidia's own 13 Oct release lists 'the impact of ceasing PH-ILD promotion and sales' as uncertain and gives no figure. A Q4/2027 outlook that removes about half of new-patient flow, and withdraws or rebases the $1B ambition, is the line this print turns on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There has never been a formal guide. The two outlook-type shocks were the 2026-09-30 ruling (-57% in a day, $70.69 to $30.26) and the 2026-10-13 settlement (+26% to +40% intraday). The stock is very sensitive to the PH-ILD question.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is still 47% below its high. But it has rallied about 42% since the settlement day (about $33.9 to $48.1) and 8% on the eve of the print, with no new company document since 14 Oct (EDGAR shows only Form 4s). The rally is therefore pricing a benign PAH-only run-rate, or continued off-label PH-ILD use, that management has not confirmed. If the market had priced a roughly 50% loss of new-patient flow, the stock would not have re-rated above the post-settlement level into the print. Sized down for the 22% short float, and net of the PAH half, which grew sales 31% q/q in Q3.
findings.independence: The roughly even split is from third-party call summaries (MarketBeat/Barchart Q1-2026 highlights, snippet only: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/liquidia-q1-earnings-call-highlights-2026-05-11/). No analyst or the company has published a PH-ILD revenue share; IBTimes (2026-10-15) states 'Liquidia has not disclosed how much of its recent sales came from PH-ILD patients' (https://www.ibtimes.com.au/liquidia-united-therapeutics-yutrepia-settlement-1876695). Countervailing: the settlement 8-K bars promotion 'immediately', and the release of claims waits on FDA approval of the label change, so Q4 PH-ILD sales may continue for a while.

findings.finding: Settlement cash: $60.3m paid in October, a $175.0m net payment due within 30 business days of 13 Oct (about 24 Nov), and 2 x $72.7m due 31 Jan and 30 Apr 2027, against $396.1m cash at 30 Sep. The HCR minimum cash covenant rose from $15m to $45m, and a third-party letter of credit was arranged. The CFO says no new financing is needed. The money buys continued PAH commercialisation, not a ramp, and leaves about $160m before Q4 operating cash flow.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on a print. The settlement day (cash drain fully disclosed) was +26%.
findings.why_not_priced: The schedule is public. What is unpriced is how the call frames cash rebuilding under a PAH-only run-rate, after R&D was guided to double in H2. An equity raise after a 74% run-up is possible but would land after the window. If a raise were priced, the stock would not be trading at its post-settlement high.
findings.independence: The same document as finding 2; the payment figures repeat in the 13 Oct release (tm2627557d1_ex99-1.htm). The two findings share the settlement 8-K but land on different lines (P&L headline vs cash).

findings.finding: The settlement does not cover new treprostinil products, and UTC may assert patents against Liquidia's development programs. Liquidia also agreed to end its PH-ILD trial cohorts. The Q2 call had guided H2-2026 R&D to roughly double H1 for Re-Spire (L606 in PH-ILD), IPF/PPF and Raynaud's. The call's promised 'pipeline priorities' update will likely cut or reshape the PH-ILD-centred pipeline: lower R&D spend, but less long-term optionality.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no precedent of the pipeline moving this stock on a print.
findings.why_not_priced: Analysts value the stock on YUTREPIA PAH sales. The scope of the UTC carve-out against L606 (Re-Spire is a PH-ILD study) has not been addressed by the company. If priced, there would be published commentary on L606's fate; none was found.
findings.independence: The R&D doubling guidance is reported in the Earnings Whispers preview (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/LQDA/22795, 2026-11-03). The PH-ILD cohort discontinuation is in UTHR filing coverage summarised in search results (Reuters via PYMNTS).

findings.finding: The short is crowded: 17.3M shares short, 22.3% of float, at 15 Oct, up from 12.64M at 30 Sep. Shorts added into the settlement rally, and the stock has since gone from about $43 to $48.12, including +8.4% on 9 Nov. Any reassuring PAH-retention number or cash commentary meets forced covering.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: +25.6% on 2026-05-11 and +13.7% on 2025-08-12 show this name gaps hard on upside surprises.
findings.why_not_priced: The put skew of +15.6 vol points prices downside, not a squeeze. Part of the 20-day run-up may already be covering, which is why this is sized at 1 point rather than at the squeeze magnitude.
findings.independence: Massive.com, 17.3M as of Oct 15 and 12.64M as of Sep 30 (https://massive.com/quote/lqda), a different aggregator of the same FINRA data.

findings.finding: Counterparty: United Therapeutics' Q3 release (2026-11-04) says competitive therapies negatively impacted Tyvaso DPI, nebulized Tyvaso and Remodulin. Nebulized Tyvaso fell 12% y/y and Tyvaso DPI rose 13% y/y, which is consistent with YUTREPIA still taking share through 30 Sep. The release gives no post-settlement patient-return commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: n/a; it confirms the pre-announced Q3.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it covers a quarter Liquidia already pre-released. The only unpriced content is that UTHR, speaking after Liquidia, did not claim an October reversal of share. If UTHR had flagged PH-ILD patients returning, LQDA would have sold off on 4-5 Nov rather than rallying.
findings.independence: Proxy only; the counterparty's numbers end 30 Sep.

outside_window.finding: The $175.0m net payment to UTC is due within 30 business days of 2026-10-13 (about 2026-11-24). Releases take effect only once the payments are made, dismissals are filed and the FDA approves removing PH-ILD from the label.
The FDA decision on the Prior Approval Supplement removing PH-ILD from the YUTREPIA label has no date given. It is the trigger for the mutual releases.
Two settlement installments of $72.7m each are due 2027-01-31 and 2027-04-30.

baseline_tension: The modest negative lean agrees with the +15.6 put skew and the extreme +74% 20-day run-up, which leaves little room for anything but sell-the-news. It cuts against a 22% short float that can squeeze on any benign PAH-retention number, so p_up is held at 46 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short against a negative): the PH-ILD guidance finding shrank from -1.5 to -1.0 because 22% of float is short; p_up moved from 45 to 46.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the money buys continued PAH commercialisation, not a ramp, and the company says no raise is needed; the finding shrank from -0.3 to -0.2.

Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the EPS/revenue consensus has one stale source, so the two headline findings that depend on it stay capped at +/-0.5. The revenue bar is the company's own pre-release, so print_vs_bar stays 0.
Lessons 1 and 9 left the set standing: reaction history is mixed (+25.6, -10.5), and the guidance finding is already sized net of PAH growth.
